_help: The Work with us page (work-with-us/, js/work-app.js). packages: what people can pay for; product is the id in data/products.json, where the real price lives. fields: the questions on the request form for each kind (key, label, type text, url or area, required true or false, optional placeholder, pattern (what a valid answer looks like), bad (what to ask for when it does not match) and hint (a line under the label; {project} becomes the project name)). statuses: the words and short explanations people see for their requests. guarantee must stay word for word.
label: Work with us
title: Put your project in front of curious people.
intro: We turn your project into a short course or a playful toy, in the web3.toys style. People learn what you do, pass a quiz and share a certificate in your colours.

packages.name: Academy course: Featured
points: 30 days featured on the Academy page

packages.name: Custom toy
points: A game or interactive toy about your project
Made with you, in our style
A share card people want to post

guarantee: Payment does not guarantee listing. Every project passes our vetting checklist first, and we refund in full if we decline.
steps: Send the form below and pay for your package.
We check your project against our vetting checklist, usually within 5 working days.
If we approve it, we build your course or toy with you. If we decline, we refund you in full.
It goes live, and you can follow every step here.
